_header: DEF_TEMPLATE_V3: a blank alarm definition, not a real alarm. Owner SCOUT (the alarm kit). New edition by SCOUT for the clean release (K7, 30 Oct 2026); old file team/RESEARCH/ALARM_DESIGN/KIT_V2/templates/DEF_TEMPLATE_V2.json 3a0b5e15a769c257 (a real alarm, N1 LQ). Every field is explained in DEF_TEMPLATE_V3.md beside it. Copy it, replace every REPLACE and the example inputs, keep the shape; this key may stay or go.

claim.one_line: REPLACE: the moment, who must trade or what changes, the expected move and its side, in one line
claim.side_meaning: REPLACE: what +1 and -1 mean, and whether the idea follows or fades that side
claim.note: REPLACE: the time scale and its reason (never a result); the codes, each read with metric_brief_v2.py

conditions.name: REPLACE: the claim in words (example: x above its own top 1 pct of the 14 days before)
REPLACE: a floor in the code's unit (example: at least 25,000 USD), or delete this condition
